summary: Petition under Section 17(3) & 17(4) of the Electricity Act, 2003 seeking approval for creation of Security Interest over the Petitioner's assets in favour of Respondent No. 4 (who is acting as the Security Trustee for the Purpose of holding the securities on behalf of and for benefit of the Lender) in terms of the security trustee agreement dated 25.03.3035 (including its assignees, transferees, novates) in respect of the petitioner's transmission project Order in Petition No. 672/MP/2025 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition seeking approval for the creation of Security Interest by way of the hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ assignment, etc., over all assets, including movable and immovable assets, project accounts and documents (including assignment of transmission licence), etc. of the Petitioner in favour of the Security Trustee (or its replacement or successor) i.e., Axis Trustee Services Limited (Respondent No. 4) to secure the financial assistance Order in Petition No. 672/MP/2025 _“a) Approve the creation of Security Interest by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ assignment (as applicable), over all assets including the assets listed at Paragraph 16 above, and all the movable and immovable assets, Transmission Project accounts, Project Documents (including assignment of transmission licence) etc., both present and future, of Petitioner in terms of the Financing Documents, or as may be agreed between the Petitioner and the Lenders from time to time, in favour of Lender/ Security Trustee to secure the financial assistance availed/ to be availed from the Lender and its subsequent transferees, assigns, novates and substitutes thereof and any refinancing lenders to the Project, by executing deed of hypothecation and power of attorney in relation thereto, Indenture of Mortgage, Mortgage by deposit of title deeds and such other security documents as per law or as may be required by the Lender from time to time through which a charge can be created; or_ _c) Pass any such other/ further order(s)/ direction(s) as this Commission may deem fit and appropriate in the facts and circumstances of the present case."_ Order in Petition No. 672/MP/2025 Order in Petition No. 672/MP/2025 this purpose, the Petitioner and Axis Bank Limited have appointed Respondent No. 4, 7. The Petitioner has submitted that pursuant to the terms of the Facility Agreement, the secured obligations are secured by, Order in Petition No. 672/MP/2025 Order in Petition No. 672/MP/2025 8. The Petitioner has submitted that in terms of the Financing Documents, the Petitioner is required to create security, which is the transaction security (as defined under the Facility Agreement), in favour of a Security Trustee for the benefit of the lender. 9. The Petitioner has stated that Article 15.2.2 of the Transmission Service Agreement entered into between the Petitioner and the beneficiaries of the project provides that the Petitioner is free to create encumbrance over all or part of the receivables, Letter of Credit or other assets of the project in favour of the lenders or the representative of the lenders as security for the amount payable under the Financing Agreements and any other amounts agreed by the parties. Order in Petition No. 672/MP/2025 11. The Petition was called out for the hearing on 5.8.2025 after notice to the Respondents. Vide Record of Proceedings for the hearing on 5.8.2025, the Respondents were granted the opportunity to file their respective replies within two weeks. However, no reply was filed by the Respondents. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part hereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._ _(4) Any agreement relating to any transaction specified in sub-section (1) or subsection (3), unless made with the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission, shall be void.”_ Order in Petition No. 672/MP/2025 Order in Petition No. 672/MP/2025 **Order in Petition No. 672/MP/2025** CERC Website S.
